records.title: Multiply and Divide Fractions — Prealgebra 2e §4.2, Find Reciprocals
records.retrieved: Official HTML Find Reciprocals definition, nonzero restriction, sign reasoning, whole-number example and comparison with opposites; current licence footer.
records.adopted: Product-one is the defining relationship. State zero exception, write whole numbers over one, and keep reciprocal separate from opposite.
records.rejected: No automatic flip rule for zero, no claim reciprocal always increases magnitude, no general fraction-division algorithm imported as a prerequisite.
records.usageRestrictions: Current page states CC BY-NC-SA and separate AI/commercial permission restrictions. Concept comparison of mathematical facts only; no protected text, exercise, media or code reused.

records.title: Reciprocals
records.organisation: Ximera, Ohio State-hosted CSCC Mathematics PreCalculus
records.retrieved: Official HTML reciprocal/zero, size and sign subsections; CC BY-NC-SA4.0 shown. No embedded graph/video review claimed.
records.adopted: Zero cannot be inverted into a valid fraction; one is its own reciprocal; both negative members can multiply to positive one.
records.rejected: Do not import limits, asymptotes or reciprocal functions. Source size paragraph contains a wording slip calling the opposite-sign A/A form value1; rely on direct arithmetic giving−1, not that sentence.
records.usageRestrictions: Page states CC BY-NC-SA4.0. No external text/diagram/code copied; own strip model.

planning.purpose: Understand a reciprocal as a multiplier producing one, with whole-number/fraction/zero boundaries.
planning.teacherObjective: Oppilas perustelee käänteisluvun tulon1 avulla, muodostaa käänteislukuparin ja erottaa käänteisluvun vastaluvusta sekä nollan poikkeuksesta.
planning.childGoal: Etsin luvulle kertoimen, jolla tulo on yksi.
planning.hook: How many fixed-size pieces fill one named whole?
planning.concreteToRepresentation: Paper unit strip and fixed template → original diagram/manual piece placement → product1 → fraction notation and reciprocal swap.
examples: 2/5 pieces:2whole pieces and half of a piece fillone;2/5·5/2=1.
Reversepair5/2 and2/5, opposed to additive inverse−2/5.
Zero has none;one is itsown;negative example optional, backed by product.
planning.interaction: Step/undo/reset/finish fixed-length positive strip model; independent open fraction fields and explicit nonexistence mode. Accept equivalent unreduced/signed fractions within bounds.
scope: Finite authored fraction cases, signed integer numerator/denominator within48, nonzero denominator; exact product-one comparison.
Physical strip only1/4 and2/5 positive lengths; optional negative case justified symbolically.
No general fraction-division proficiency claim or volume-unit conversion.
planning.repair: Bothinput/change for numerator/denominator/mode/target retire dependent verdict; explicitcheck reads current visible fields. Invariant model steps preserve it. Unsupported selectorkeys/modes/bounds reject.
planning.transfer: One litre divided into fixed quarter-litre portions:4portions, with count distinct from portion volume.
limits: Onscreen support does not demonstrate physical cutting/measurement, general fraction division, retention, independent/formal mastery or efficacy.
